comparison.objective: Separate media from finished washers, versus pulling a cable out to a length mark.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual sifting and granular-flow control versus controlled cable feeding, tension and length positioning.
comparison.success_condition: Media recovery and no loss versus cable extended to the marked length without unsafe displacement.
comparison.reason: The record tests linear manipulation of a flexible cable, not aperture-mediated sorting.
